kultivator.technique.own_art_1.desc: An ultimate you create yourself in the inner world: two comprehended Daos fused into one form you choose (cut, burst, rain, wave, domain or seal), under a name you give it. Its strength follows its Perfection.
kultivator.technique.own_art_1.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 1379 "Incredible Power" (Meng Hao calls his last Hex his own Ninth Hex) · Battle Through the Heavens ch. 262 (Xiao Yan merges two Heavenly Flames into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame) · Coiling Dragon (Linley fuses profound mysteries); slots, forms, numbers and naming are game design
kultivator.technique.own_art_1.lore: No master taught it. No scripture holds it. It is yours.
